verdict.rationale: Amplitude exposes broad APIs (HTTP V2 ingestion, Export, Dashboard REST, Behavioral Cohorts, Experiment APIs for flags/experiments/deployments) and an MCP server that lets AI tools query behavioral data and get answers, showing real API-parity ambition. However, many UI-centric features—visual A/B test editor, session replay capture/viewing, in-product guides/surveys creation, heatmaps—are described only as UI capabilities with no documented API equivalent for creation/management. missing for 10: API/endpoint documentation for creating or managing session replay, visual A/B test editor, in-product guides/surveys, and heatmap configuration; independent confirmation that API coverage is truly at parity with UI
